hero.title: Hang Out With Jesus
hero.body: Hang Out With Jesus (HOWJ) is more than an event; it's a divine mandate inspired by the words of Matthew 28:19 — “Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost.” Our mission is to bring people together across nations to experience the love, power, and presence of Jesus Christ.

stats.label: Souls documented for Christ in person

story.headline: Together, we're taking the love, power and presence of Jesus to the nations.
notes: HOWJ began in 2021 with a single gathering in London — one goal: bring people together to experience Jesus.
What started as one revival has become a movement — ten expressions across four continents, each one revealing Jesus by a new name.
Along the way thousands have assembled, souls have been documented for Christ, and communities have been served through charity outreach.

timeline.title: Jesus Christ — The Way, The Truth, The Life
timeline.text: HOWJ 1.0. Three days in London launch the mandate (John 14:6).

timeline.title: Jesus Christ — The Answer

timeline.title: Jesus Christ — The Light of the World
timeline.text: HOWJ 3.0 crosses the Atlantic to Chicago (John 8:12).

timeline.title: Jesus Christ — The Governor Among the Nations
timeline.text: HOWJ 4.0 lands on African soil in Lagos (Psalm 22:28).

timeline.title: Jesus Christ — The Same Yesterday, Today and Forever
Jesus Christ — The Lion of the Tribe of Judah

timeline.title: Jesus Christ — The Lord is That Spirit
timeline.text: HOWJ 7.0 goes to Asia — South Korea (2 Corinthians 3:17).

timeline.title: Jesus Christ — Name Above All Names
timeline.text: HOWJ 10.0 in Atlanta (Philippians 2:9-11). Next stop: Jamaica.

people.heading: Our people make HOWJ
